marketing.heroTitle: Your apartment, explained before they ask
marketing.heroSubtitle: Wi-Fi, check-in, house rules and local tips behind one QR code. Guests scan it and find everything in their own language.
marketing.stepOneBody: Start from a ready-made guide and change anything you like in the editor.
marketing.stepTwoBody: Hang it in the apartment. The code is permanent, so it never needs reprinting.
marketing.stepThreeBody: In English, Spanish or Polish, chosen automatically from their phone.
marketing.featureGuideBody: Wi-Fi, check-in, parking, appliances, house rules and check-out, all in one place.
marketing.featureIssueBody: Guests describe the issue and attach a photo. No phone calls at midnight.
marketing.featureReviewBody: Point guests at your review page at the right moment, after a good stay.
marketing.featureBrandBody: Your logo, your colours, your photos. It looks like part of your business.
marketing.featureLanguageBody: Write once per language and guests get the one their phone is set to.
marketing.featureEditorTitle: A block editor, not a ticket to support
marketing.featureEditorBody: Change text, colours, photos and sections yourself, and publish when you are ready.
marketing.pricingTitle: Pick a plan and try it free for 14 days
marketing.pricingSubtitle: Test every feature and choose the plan that matches how you work. You only pay if you decide to continue.
marketing.faqOneQ: Do I need a card to start?
marketing.faqOneA: No. The 14-day trial asks for no payment details, and nothing happens automatically when it ends.
marketing.faqTwoQ: What happens when the trial ends?
marketing.faqTwoA: Your guest site stays online for guests. You will not be able to edit it until you pick a plan.
marketing.faqThreeQ: Do I need to reprint the QR code if I rename my apartment?
marketing.faqThreeA: Never. The printed code points at a permanent address that we redirect, so renaming or moving your site keeps it working.
marketing.faqFourQ: Can I use my own domain?
marketing.faqFourA: Custom domains are on the roadmap. For now every apartment gets its own address on ours.
marketing.finalCtaTitle: Ready to raise the standard of your apartment?
marketing.finalCtaBody: Set up your guide in about five minutes and see how much it takes off your plate.
marketing.faqFiveA: By card as a monthly or yearly subscription, or for a whole year at once with BLIK, Przelewy24 or card. Every payment comes with an invoice showing your company's tax number.
